name: py-sources
description: The 8 vulnerability feeds, run on a staging database

sources.name: cvelist
sources.description: CVE List v5 (CVEProject/cvelistV5) with CISA Vulnrichment ADP data

sources.name: debian-tracker
sources.description: Debian Security Tracker: per-release status, urgency, no-dsa and DSA/DLA ids

sources.name: epss
sources.description: FIRST EPSS exploitation probability scores (daily bulk or API lookup)

sources.name: euvd
sources.description: ENISA EUVD: exploited and recent EU vulnerability records, with CVE aliases

sources.name: kev
sources.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (full snapshot)

sources.name: msrc
sources.description: Microsoft MSRC CVRF v3: per-product fixed builds + KBs for Windows/Office/.NET (API blocked in sandbox)

sources.name: nvd
sources.description: NVD CVE API 2.0: CVSS, CWE and CPE applicability
